provenance.forecast: Meteomatics Weather API: mix (15 days), ecmwf-vareps and ecmwf-mmsf ensembles (51 members)
provenance.normals: NASA POWER 1991-2020 for the same calendar dates -- a different source from the forecast

provenance.source: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 NDVI (Terra, 250 m, 16-day) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
provenance.mask: stable cropland, io-lulc 2017-2023, fraction >= 0.5 every year

provenance.source: Impact Observatory/Esri 10 m annual land cover (io-lulc-annual-v02) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
provenance.classes: Embrapa (1979), Sumula da 10a Reuniao Tecnica de Levantamento de Solos; relief classes as reproduced in Santos et al., Manual de Descricao e Coleta de Solo no Campo (SBCS/Embrapa).

rotations.formula: total = sum(weight_i * score_i) / sum(weight_i), over components with weight > 0; score_i = min-max 0-100 across candidates (100 = best)

provenance.climate: NASA POWER daily; ET0 FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (pipeline/agromet.py)
provenance.soil: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 wv0033/wv1500 at the IBGE centroid (modelled, 250 m)
provenance.water_model: FAO-56 Eqs. 73, 80-88 and chapter 11, https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm. Simplified to one bucket, roots at maximum depth from sowing, no runoff, and an evaporation cut-off at TEW.
provenance.revenue: IBGE PAM table 1612, last 5 years, nominal R$
provenance.yield_anomalies: IBGE PAM yield anomalies by ENSO class (composites)
provenance.limitations: one-bucket soil water balance with modelled soil properties (SoilGrids) and maximum rooting depth from sowing; gross revenue, not margin; scores are relative among these candidates

provenance.climate: NASA POWER daily (grid-cell average at the IBGE centroid); ETCCDI indices
provenance.yield: IBGE PAM via SIDRA (tables 1612, 839); linear-trend anomalies
